name: Magnetic Sunshade for Windshield
description: Keep your car's interior cool with this magnetic sunshade that snaps onto the windshield frame. The reflective surface blocks up to 95% of UV rays, reducing cabin temperature and protecting upholstery. Simple to install and remove without leaving residue.
shortDescription: Magnetic windshield sunshade that blocks up to 95% of UV rays.
